jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Nucs AI 
 Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity. 
 We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice. 
 Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves. 
 
 The Opportunity 
 Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas. This is not a role where you manage a feature backlog in isolation; you will be expected to build conviction around what we should build, why, and in what order, and to defend that thinking rigorously. 
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Product Development Support 
 Own the roadmap for one or more product lines (e.g., DeepPSMA, SelectPSMA, TrackPSMA), balancing clinical impact, technical feasibility, and business value. 

 Engage directly with clinicians, nuclear medicine physicians, and oncologists to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and decision-making processes. 

 Translate ambiguous, technically complex problems into well-structured product requirements and clear success criteria. 

 Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision. 

 Navigate the regulatory landscape (FDA, CE marking) as a stakeholder, you do not need to be a regulatory expert, but you must understand how regulatory requirements shape product decisions and timelines. 

 Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Drive cross-functional execution with engineering, AI/ML, clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders, keeping a small team moving fast without sacrificing quality. 

 Contribute to go-to-market strategy, positioning, and customer enablement alongside commercial and clinical teams. 

 Analytics & Insights 
 Define and track meaningful product metrics; use data and user feedback to inform iteration and prioritization decisions. 

 
 
 What You Bring 
 3-6 years of product management experience in a B2B or technical environment building products for specialized, professional users (not purely consumer products). 

 Demonstrated ability to manage complex products where the user base has deep domain expertise, e.g., enterprise software, developer tools, scientific instruments, industrial platforms, or similar. 

 Strong conceptual and systems thinking. You can see the big picture, connect disparate inputs into a coherent product thesis, and reason about second-order effects. You don't just execute, you think. 

 Startup or high-growth experience. You have worked in an environment where speed, ambiguity, and wearing multiple hats were the norm, not the exception. 

 Excellent communication skills. You can write clearly, present a compelling argument, and facilitate productive discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 Comfort with technical depth. You do not need to write code, but you should be able to engage meaningfully with engineers and data scientists on architecture, data, and tradeoff discussions. 

 Intellectual curiosity and learning agility. You pick up new domains quickly and enjoy becoming a quasi-expert in areas you previously knew nothing about. 

 Fluency in English (native or professional proficiency required - C1 level or higher) 
 

 Bonus Points 
 Experience in healthcare, medtech, health-AI, or a regulated industry. 

 Familiarity with medical imaging, oncology workflows, or clinical decision support. 

 Experience working with AI/ML-driven products where model behavior shapes the user experience. 

 Exposure to FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking processes for software as a medical device (SaMD). 

 
 Why Nucs AI 
 Mission with real impact – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated. 

 Ground-floor opportunity – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influ

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Purpose of Position

Our Product Team is looking for a passionate and dedicated colleague to join them and build world-class products to move the performance marketing industry forward.

In this role, you will work closely with both internal and external developers to build plugins, connectors and other integrations including with e-commerce and customer data platforms. You will support the product backlog management and ensure that our products meet customer needs and business objectives.

This is an exciting role where you will build and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape and industry trends. 

If you care about delivering products that customers love, enjoy working with different cultures, and meeting people from around the world, this position is a great opportunity for you. Join our team at our Product Hubs in Berlin, London, Amsterdam or Milan, or work from another country where Awin has an office.

 

What you'll be responsible for:

  • In this role, you will collaborate with product managers to manage the backlog.
  • You will liaise between internal and external engineers, the UX team, and stakeholders to ensure clear communication of product requirements.
  • You will monitor product performance metrics and generate reports to support data-driven decision making.
  • You will partner with customer-facing teams to gather customer feedback and insights, and use that feedback to inform product development decisions
  • You will identify opportunities with product peers to further add value to our plugins and various platform integrations
  • You will work with the Product Marketing team to communicate releases and drive adoption of existing and new products
  • You will develop and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce, customer-data platform landscape, and industry trends to inform product strategy for platform integrations

 

Your skills

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • You have first experience or curiosity about working in product development
  • You have experience or high-level understanding of Ecommerce or similar platforms
  • You are comfortable with web technologies
  • You are data driven and possess analytical and problem-solving skills
  • You are comfortable in communicating with multiple stakeholders
  • You are self-motivated, organised, capable of prioritising work and focusing on important tasks

 

Our Offer

  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
  • Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
  • Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (UK Loans)
jobs.description:
About Zable
 Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money .
 Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

 The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

 Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan 

 Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

 Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

 Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

 Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

 What we're looking for 

 Essential 
 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale

 Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery

 Excellent prioritisation: a clear, defensible way of ranking competing opportunities by expected impact, effort and risk, the confidence to say no, and the ability to explain trade-offs to stakeholders

 A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just ship

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
jobs.description:
Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.
 Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.
 You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.
 This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.
 
 
 About DataSnipper 
 
 The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.
 And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 
 
 
 The problems you'll own 
 
 A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

 Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

 A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

 Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

 Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress
 

 What you'll do 
 
 Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

 Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

 Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

 Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

 Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

 Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

 Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

 Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

 
 What you bring 
 
 A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

 Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

 Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

 Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

 System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and A

jobs.title: Product Manager (US Cards)
jobs.description:
About Zable
 Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money .
 Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

 The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

 Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan 

 Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

 Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.
 The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.
 Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.
 
 Join us if you want to
 Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

 Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

 Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

  
 In six years, Zable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.
 A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.
 If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.
 
 About the role 
 We're hiring a Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.
 No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.
 
 What you'll work on 
 Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

 Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

 Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

 Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

 Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

 Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team
 

 What we're looking for 
 Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.
 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

 You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

 You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

 You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

 You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

 You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

 You like days that look different from each other

 Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

 Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specif

 Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

 link

We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers, and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. Recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years, Aveni powers compliance monitoring, adviser guidance, and AI automation across regulated environments.
 
 We are seeking an Enablement / Training Manager to plan and deliver the training that turns new users of Aveni Assist and Aveni Detect into confident, everyday power users.
 
 The Role 
 You’ll be the engine room of a growing enablement team. You’ll run training for client users, organise schedules and agendas, secure time in busy diaries, and nurture people from first login to everyday use. With thousands of users using Aveni, and enterprise clients with thousands of advisers, there is real scale and impact to this role.
 
 What You’ll Be Doing

 Nurture & Drive Adoption: Follow up after training sessions, identify users who need extra support, and help embed Aveni tools into daily workflows.

 Manage New-Joiner Onboarding: Maintain a steady, scalable onboarding path for new starters across client firms.

 Maintain & Author Content: Keep user guides, video walkthroughs, and LMS courses up to date, including the official Aveni Certification program.

 Track & Report Telemetry: Monitor attendance, completion rates, and adoption metrics, sharing actionable insights with Customer Success and Product teams.

 What We’re Looking For 
 
 Essential Experience & Competencies 
 Software Training & Adoption: Proven track record of training users on software platforms and actively nurturing them into regular, long-term habits.

 Operational & Logistical Excellence: Exceptional organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules, agendas, and logistics across multiple cohort groups simultaneously.

 High-Energy Facilitation: Confident, engaging communicator in both digital and face-to-face environments with strong audience rapport.

 Stakeholder Management: Comfortable interacting directly with client end-users, team leads, and senior managers.

 Nice to Have 
 Wealth Management / FS Background: Experience as a paraplanner, adviser, or adviser support professional. If you have this domain background and are eager to learn, we encourage you to apply even with less formal software-training experience.

 What We Offer

 We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor.
 lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.
 We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you.
 
 Your Mission: 
 As Senior Product Manager, Investing, you own this domain end to end. You set its strategy and roadmap, run discovery and delivery, and answer for its outcomes. You represent the domain to some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe and to our dwpbank counterparts, and you are the go-to person internally, collaborating where it moves us forward and holding the line where it matters.
 Reporting to the Head of Product, you lead the domain's product work. The remit is large, strategically and in delivery, and it grows as the domain grows. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.
 
 You will: 
 Own the Investing product domain and its outcomes, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration

 Run product discovery and delivery inside a cross-functional crew with operations and engineering

 Shape and drive the strategy and roadmap for the entire domain: order flow, execution, trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the instrument universe

 Act as the domain go-to person and go-to expert for everything that happens before and after an order

 Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects: scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise

 Partner with risk, finance, and compliance so that what we build is compliant by design

 Work across other product teams and solutions engineering to keep partner-specific integrations sustainable on our platform
 

 You will be successful in this role if: 
 You have at least four years of product experience and have independently shipped complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.

 You have strong product craft , combining customer insight, business thinking and technical understanding to make sound product decisions.

 You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are comfortable experimenting with them, challenging their limitations and finding practical ways to improve your output.

 You are comfortable with ambiguity , bringing structure to unclear problem spaces and making confident decisions before every answer is available.

 You use data and evidence to guide your decisions , while remaining open to changing your position when new information emerges.

 You build trust across Engineering, Compliance and enterprise partnerships , communicate clearly in writing and bring the energy to challenge assumptions and move people forward.

 You thrive on ownership. You are intrinsically motivated to create impact by delivering high quality outcomes for our customers by taking initiative and challenging the status quo.

 You have a collaborative mindset . Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes natural to you. While you will have a lot of autonomy delivering your projects, you understand the necessity of cross-functional work, a certain pragmatism & dedication to our mission.

 You are a great communicator in English and German . . Working in a start-up can be messy & unstructured at times, you’re able to sift through the noise, and assess what's really critical. You create buy-in for your plans from your stakeholders by applying a strong writing culture.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us. 
 Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.
 At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.
 
 Customer Success at Duffel 
 Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel.
 
 The Role 
 We're hiring a Senior Project Implementation Manager to own every new customer's journey from signed contract to a live, transacting integration. This is a new, senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success, with a direct line of sight to the leadership team.
 You'll run each onboarding as a project with a plan, a date and named owners, working with our Solutions Engineer so customers go live on time and with the right setup for their proposition. You'll also hold the view across every onboarding in flight, give the leadership team a clear, regular read on progress and risk, and work with internal teams to remove friction, automate manual steps and shorten the time it takes customers to go live.
 Our customers include some of the largest fintech and software platforms in the world, building flights, stays and more on top of Duffel's API. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.
 
 What You’ll be doing: 
 Own each onboarding end to end: take the handover from Sales at contract signature, run a structured kick-off, and lead the customer through to go-live and their first live bookings.

 Build and run a project plan for every onboarding, covering commercial setup, API integration milestones, payments and finance setup, testing and launch, and be the customer's single point of contact for status.

 Pull in the right people across Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering, Payments, Finance and Travel Operations, spot blockers early, and escalate when a date slips.

 Keep one source of truth for every onboarding in flight, prioritise across them, and report weekly to the VP, Customer Success and monthly to the leadership team.

 Build a repeatable onboarding playbook, track time-to-live, on-time go-live rate and time to first transaction, and feed recurring friction back to Product and Engineering.

 What we're looking for: 
 5+ years running customer onboarding, implementation or technical project delivery in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or another API-first business, with a track record of getting several complex onboardings live on time at once.

 Enough technical fluency to follow API-led integrations (REST APIs, webhooks, sandbox vs production, test plans) and hold your own with engineers. You don't need to write code.

 Confidence with senior customer stakeholders, and calm, direct escalation: you raise a slipping date early, with a proposed fix and a named owner.

 Experience building process where little exists, such as a playbook, tracker or reporting cadence, and getting other teams to adopt it, plus clear written status reports a leadership team can read in two minutes.

 Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in travel tech, onboarding enterprise platforms that embed a third-party API, or being the first person in a new function is a bonus.

 What you'll be working on 
 In your first 30 days: getting to know every onboarding in flight, who's involved and where each one is stuck, with a single tracker in place and a first status report to leadership.

 By 90 days: every new customer gets a kick-off, a project plan and a committed go-live date, a v1 onboarding playbook is in use, and baseline time-to-live is measured.

 Designing the onboarding model by segment, from white-glove onboarding for large platforms to a lighter, scalable path for smaller accounts.

 In your first year: time-to-live measurably shorter, most onboardings going live on the date agreed at kick-off, and a playbook solid enough to hand to the next hire into the team.

 Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel 
 We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.
 Perks That Actually Matter: 
 ✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.
 🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatic

jobs.title: Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced full service Project Manager in the field of clinical trials who’s engaged in addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology. Are you passionate about impacting the health and lives of patients around the world? Do you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in trial operational delivery?

Precision for Medicine are looking to hire a Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager with experience in Oncology who have managed full service clinical trials within a CRO setting to join our global team.

In this pivotal role you will have full service oversight for clinical projects across global/regional (ph I-IV) trials, within Oncology.  Accountable for clinical project delivery, oversight of all functional departments, and ensuring agreed timelines, scope, cost and quality.

Involved in all study stages, including proposal strategy, development, costing, and bid defence, and seeing studies through the full cycle to completion, managing the client relationship, project team and budget and timelines throughout.

You will work in a cross-functional team with both internal and external stakeholders, driving quality and coordinating the study team.

We offer an amazing high-energy, dedicated, collaborative team members who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments. If you are no stranger to taking charge and seek positive teamwork to deliver extraordinary work, we have an opportunity for you.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

  • You will independently lead clinical projects in accordance with the study budget and scope of work. You will use your strong interpersonal and organizational skills to set and achieve objectives in the execution of the projects; both contracted objectives and financial objectives. You may be called upon to run international trials as well.
  • Serve as the primary point-of-contact liaison with the client to provide excellent customer service, including participation in proposal activities and client presentations
  • Liaise with Project Team and senior management of both Precision and sponsors, including C level
  • Handle and lead all aspects of a clinical research trial or trials
  • Total project management for all functional areas including data management, safety, clinical, medical monitoring and biostatistics, etc.
  • Prepare project status updates for clients and management; identifying key deliverables and performance metrics of success and escalation.
  • Serve as an active member of the Project Team with the goal to contribute towards efficient management and execution of trials
  • Prepare and reviews protocols and other study documentation such as project plans, inform consents, site contracts and budgets

Requirements:

  • Degree or similar related life science qualification, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Previous experience in a full service/global Project Management role working in the CRO industry is essential.
  • Extensive experience working within Clinical Operations position within a CRO, and at least 4 years full service Project Management experience in a clinical trial setting working for a Clinical Research Organisation.
    • Experience managing studies within Oncology 
    • Working understanding of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process
  • Ability to drive and availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays
  • Be able to communicate effectively in the English language both written and spoken
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Proven computer skills (MS Office, MS Project, PowerPoint) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS)
  • Proven ability to develop positive working relationships with individual and teams internally and externally
  • Demonstrated core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities as it relates to the execution of a clinical development plan

Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development. 

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.

jobs.title: Sr. MarTech Specialist, Attribution & Performance
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance 

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
 The team 
 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
 The opportunity 
 As a Sr. MarTech Specialist for Attribution and Performance, you will support attribution and performance measurement at Payward by owning the data and processes that keep it accurate, and by acting as the bridge between our engineers and our performance marketing team. You will form part of a wider MarTech team and partner closely with finance and compliance so that measurement stays accurate and follows our safety and compliance practices. You will also use AI as a core part of how you work, moving quickly and sharing what you learn with the team. Key responsibilities include:
 Attribution: 
 Drive attribution across web and app, covering conversion definitions, touchpoint credit and journeys stitched together across 3rd party vendors and our inhouse data platforms.

 Reconcile ad platform, MMP, analytics and internal numbers, and explain the gaps in plain language.

 Investigate discrepancies caused by vendor configuration, attribution methodology, fraud or bugs in our own apps.

 Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to speed up investigation, SQL, specs and reporting, share what works with the team and contribute to team Agent.

 Contribute to the roadmap for the next level of attribution, such as incrementality testing, LTV-based optimisation and marketing mix modelling.

 Engineering partnership: 
 Turn performance marketing needs into clear specs and tickets for engineering, covering event design, deep links, SDK changes and server-side tracking, and review what ships.

 Work with engineers and data owners to keep the signals ad platforms optimise on (Meta, Google and TikTok conversion APIs and postbacks) complete, deduplicated and consent-compliant.

 Audit and standardise event naming, properties and volume, with monitoring in place to catch breakages early.

 Performance and cross-functional support: 
 Run a regular rhythm with performance marketing on attribution health, discrepancies and test readouts.

 Put a measurement plan in place before spend goes live on new channels, launches and tests, and own the readout afterwards.

 Support weekly and monthly reporting cycles, maintain the attribution dashboards the performance team relies on, and support spend and invoice reconciliation with finance.

 Work directly with MMP and ad platform reps and vendor support, escalating with evidence.

 Work with compliance to keep tracking, conversion signals and reporting aligned with Payward's safety and compliance practices, including consent, privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and financial promotion rules.

 Set up monitoring and alerts for tracking breakages, fraud and volatility-driven spikes in traffic and conversions, such as sharp market moves, and escalate per policy.

 Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, finance, design, data and performance marketing, and prioritise requests openly.

 
  
 What you bring 
 5+ years of experience in MarTech, performance marketing technology, growth analytics or a related digital marketing field.

 Hands-on experience with web and mobile attribution, including MMPs (such as AppsFlyer or Branch), SKAN, deep linking and web-to-app journeys.

 Understanding of why ad platforms credit conversions differently, and experience with conversion APIs and server-side tracking for Meta, Google Ads and TikTok.

 Comfortable working with data: SQL and a data warehouse, able to read an event schema and trace a discrepancy back to its source.

 An AI-native way of working: you already use AI assistants and agents day to day for analysis, SQL, scripting, documentation and automation, move fast with them, check their output before relying on it, and follow our data privacy and security rules when doing so.

 Experience working within safety and compliance practices in a regulated environment, such as consent and financial promotion rules, and monitoring data and alerts through volatile periods when traffic and conversions swing quickly.

 Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills,

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects.

The Role

We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has lived inside community products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong, and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.

What You'll Own

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above
  • Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift
  • Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan
  • Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity
  • Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions
  • Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform
  • Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained
  • Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition
  • Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting
  • Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you

Nice to Have

  • Experience building privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms
  • Fam

 You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.
 Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

 The Opportunity 
 The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building.

As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does.
 You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it.

 Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff.

 Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update.

 Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse.

 Produktentwicklung steuern: Du behältst die verschiedenen Teilprojekte im Blick, erkennst Abhängigkeiten und sorgst dafür, dass Funktionen in einer sinnvollen Reihenfolge entwickelt werden.

 Komplexität für Nutzer*innen reduzieren: Du übersetzt komplexes Expertenwissen rund um Gründungsprozesse in einfache, intuitive digitale Anwendungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du die unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen von Gründerinnen – von der ersten Geschäftsidee über die Gründung bis hin zum Wachstum. Dein Anspruch: Nutzerinnen finden in jeder Phase die passende Unterstützung, ohne selbst Expert*innen sein zu müssen.

 Nutzererlebnisse konzipieren: Du entwickelst mit Figma eigenständig User Flows, Wireframes und interaktive Prototypen, überprüfst Konzepte anhand von Nutzerfeedback und optimierst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team.

 Entwicklung konkret voranbringen: Du übersetzt Anforderungen in verständliche User Stories und Entwicklungstickets, priorisierst das Product Backlog und klärst fachliche Fragen direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam.

 Roadmap und Qualität im Blick behalten: Gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung und Projektleitung planst du realistische Entwicklungsschritte, begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Go-live und nutzt Feedback und KPIs für die weitere Optimierung.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager – Local Control System
jobs.description:
Role
 You’ll build our in-house local control system from scratch: the on-site controller hardware and the software that decides how each battery charges and discharges. You own the product across hardware and software, from the first design to a reliable system running across our fleet.
  
 What you will do
 You will work with a dedicated developer team, and closely with our data scientists and Operations team. Your responsibilities will be:
 Define the local control software, including dispatch logic, control strategies, fallbacks and interfaces to batteries, meters and the central platform.

 Enable our Operations team to bring new sites live through tooling, documentation and hands-on support.

 Own the product backlog, prioritize requirements across Operations, grid operations and the central platform, and work with developers from specification through release.

 Design a configuration schema that works across all sites without requiring site-specific logic.

 Own field reliability, including edge device requirements, testing, safety, release management and fleet-wide updates.

 Drive the integration of power plant controllers and protection devices, and own IT security and the software requirements for grid services prequalification.

  
 What we are looking for
 Experience with software that controls physical systems and being in a product role, ideally in energy (battery storage, PV, inverters, SCADA or similar). Having taken a product from zero to one is a strong plus.

 A strong technical background, typically in electrical engineering, computer science or a related field.

 Experience working with developers as a product owner: writing specifications, setting priorities, etc.

 You understand how batteries, meters and grid connections work in practice and can discuss interfaces and protocols with engineers.

 You think in failure modes and safe states, not just the happy path.

 Fluent in English. German is a plus, as you will work with grid operators and partners in Germany.

 Nice to have: German grid codes and standards, IT security for operational technology, prequalification for balancing services, or experience rolling out software to many distributed devices (e.g. IoT or OTA updates).

  
 What it means to work at BEO
 We are a small team taking on a hard problem, and we hold ourselves to a high bar. We value ownership, direct and honest communication, and getting better every day. If you like solving complex problems, you'll fit right in.

 Our office is in central Munich. We offer plenty of flexibility but ask for an office-first commitment. People learn faster and get more done together.

 We offer a competitive salary, equity upside in the company, and top-notch equipment (you choose what you need).

 You'll join us early in our journey. The foundations are in place, but it's still essentially day one, with plenty of opportunity to shape how we tackle one of the most significant challenges of our time.

  
 Next steps
 We move fast. Most processes are completed within 2 weeks. Apply if this sounds like you.

jobs.title: Product Manager - H/F
jobs.description:
Chez Hubvisory, on confie de vrais produits à nos PM. 👋
 
 Tu rejoins l’équipe produit d’un de nos clients grands comptes, et c’est toi qui as la main sur ton produit. D’une mission à l’autre, tu changes d’univers : retail, luxe, banque, secteur public. Peu de postes te font voir autant de contextes en si peu de temps.
 
 🎯 Tes missions 
 Discovery : tu vas voir les utilisateurs, tu mènes les entretiens et tu valides tes hypothèses avant de lancer quoi que ce soit en dev

 Conception : tu construis les solutions avec les designers, du prototype jusqu’aux tests utilisateurs

 Delivery : tu tiens le backlog et la roadmap et tu arbitres les priorités. Le client t’écoute parce que tu arrives avec des arguments

 Pilotage : tu suis tes KPI et tes OKR après chaque mise en prod, et tu fais évoluer ta roadmap avec ce que tu observes

 Animation : tu animes les rituels agiles et les ateliers avec les équipes et les métiers côté client

 Partage : tu présentes ce que tu as appris en mission aux autres PM Hubvisory, et tu profites de ce qu’ils ont appris eux aussi
 

 Tu ne pars jamais seul(e) : un manager te suit pendant tes missions, et tu peux compter sur la communauté produit dès que tu bloques sur un sujet.
 
 🧭 Ton évolution 
 Après le grade Confirmé vient le grade Senior, avec des contextes plus exigeants et des PM plus juniors à accompagner. La plupart de nos managers et leads ont commencé consultants chez nous, donc ton prochain poste peut très bien être en interne.
 
 💡 Pourquoi Hubvisory 
 On fait du Product et de l’IA depuis 2016, et rien d’autre. Autour de toi, tout le monde parle produit

 Tu interviens chez Dior, Decathlon, Leroy Merlin, France TV…

 Tu commences par deux semaines au Campus Hubvisory avant ta première mission, puis tu as accès à plus de 1 000 h de contenus

 Ton salaire est revu deux fois par an

 Quand l’entreprise va bien, tu en profites directement : jusqu’à 22 % des profits sont redistribués en intéressement, à parts égales
 

 💰 Salaire : 46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel, plus l’intéressement et les primes (commerciale, ancienneté sur mission, cooptation).
 
 
 👤 Ton profil 
 Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience comme PM sur des produits digitaux dans des environnements grands comptes

 Tu as déjà fait de la discovery avec de vrais utilisateurs, et tu as envie d’en faire plus

 Backlog, priorisation, roadmap : tu connais, et tu as envie de pratiquer dans d’autres contextes

 Tu aimes convaincre, et défendre une décision face à un client ne te fait pas peur
 

 🔄 Le process 
 Un premier échange avec l’équipe RH

 Un cas pratique en live avec un Manager (1h30)

 Un entretien avec un VP ou un des cofondateurs (1h30)

 Un appel RH de 15 minutes pour la proposition

 Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

jobs.title: Product Manager F/H
jobs.description:
Aujourd'hui, une IA sait remplir un backlog.
 Rédiger des user stories, synthétiser des entretiens, proposer une priorisation : la production devient une commodité. Ce qui ne l'est pas : décider de ce qui mérite d'être construit, puis fédérer une organisation autour de cette décision.
 C'est ce métier que tu exerces chez Hubvisory. Tu interviens auprès de grands comptes comme Club Med, SNCF, TF1 ou Saint-Gobain, sur des produits où les arbitrages sont structurants. Tu n'exécutes pas un brief : tu le challenges.
 
 Tes missions 
 Identifier ce qui crée de la valeur. Entretiens utilisateurs, JTBD, story mapping. Tu pars d'hypothèses et tu construis des preuves.

 Arbitrer. Roadmap, OKR, priorisation : tu tranches entre enjeux business, usages et contraintes tech, et tu assumes tes choix face à des interlocuteurs exigeants.

 Piloter le delivery. Backlog, rituels, environnement agile. Tu tiens le rôle de PM en autonomie et tu challenges les pratiques de la squad.

 Mesurer ton impact et défendre tes décisions. Tu définis les indicateurs, tu suis les résultats de tes choix et tu les portes devant les parties prenantes.

 Faire de l'IA un levier. Tu l'utilises pour gagner en efficacité, en gardant la maîtrise de ton jugement.
 

 Notre objectif : faire de toi un PM reconnu pour sa capacité à décider en contexte d'incertitude. Selon ton appétence, ton évolution se construit vers Senior, Product Leader, Manager ou Principal.
 
 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory 
 Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire.

 Un rôle sur le quoi, pas seulement sur le comment. Notre positionnement Product & IA nous place là où se crée la valeur.

 Une progression alignée sur ton impact. Revalorisations salariales bi-annuelles, passages de grade fondés sur la performance et non sur l'ancienneté.

 Un onboarding structuré. Un parcours collectif et individuel, avec un plan de formation et une montée en charge progressive. Tu es accompagné par un buddy et un mentor dédiés, et tu as accès à 1000h de contenu à la carte.

 Une taille humaine. Avec 135+ consultants, chacun est identifié, écouté et accompagné.

 
 Le profil recherché 
 3 à 5 ans d'expérience comme PM / PO sur des produits digitaux. Une expérience en conseil ou en grand groupe est un vrai plus.

 Indispensables : maîtrise de la Discovery et du Delivery, capacité à avancer sans cadrage parfait, culture de la mesure d'impact.

 Atouts : usage concret de l'IA dans ta pratique produit, culture SAFe ou agilité à l'échelle.

 Savoir-être : autonomie, posture client solide, engagement dans le collectif (chez Hubvisory, tu t’impliques à la fois chez client et au sein du cabinet).
 

 Le process de recrutement 
 Échange avec un RH : ton projet, notre modèle, tes attentes (45 min)

 Cas pratique avec un Manager : hard skills, en live (90 min)

 Projection stratégique avec un VP ou un cofondateur : posture et vision (90 min)

 Échange de closing avec un RH (15 min)

 Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - ASRS
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec , nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.
 Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.
 Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.
 La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?
 Au sein du département Product Management , vous prenez la responsabilité de la Product Line ASRS — Automated Storage and Retrieval System, le produit phare des systèmes Exotec.
 L’ASRS regroupe la partie robotique du Skypod System. Cette Product Line constitue un élément central de la proposition de valeur d’Exotec et mobilise environ 100 personnes au sein de la R&D.
 En tant que Product Director ASRS, vous définissez la vision, la stratégie et les priorités de cette Product Line. Vous donnez une direction claire aux équipes et travaillez au quotidien avec les fonctions R&D, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success et les équipes projet afin de faire évoluer une solution industrielle critique, performante et différenciante.
 Missions
 En tant que Product Director ASRS, vos missions consistent à :
 Définir la vision, la stratégie et le positionnement de la Product Line ASRS, en cohérence avec la stratégie globale d’Exotec
 Orienter une organisation R&D d’environ 100 personnes autour de priorités produit claires et partagées
 Définir et piloter la roadmap ASRS, en arbitrant les priorités entre valeur client, performance opérationnelle, différenciation technologique, qualité et capacité de développement
 Comprendre les enjeux des opérations logistiques et les besoins des clients utilisant le Skypod System
 Collecter et analyser les besoins du marché, en lien étroit avec les clients, les équipes commerciales, les équipes projet, le marketing et les intégrateurs
 Identifier les opportunités d’évolution de la robotique
 Garantir la cohérence fonctionnelle de l'ensemble de nos produits, en particulier aux interfaces
 Définir les critères de succès des évolutions produit et suivre leur adoption, leur performance et leur impact opérationnel
 Contribuer au positionnement de l’offre, à la définition de sa proposition de valeur et à son évolution commerciale
 Préparer et accompagner les lancements de produits et de fonctionnalités sur les différents marchés internationaux
 Communiquer la vision, les choix et les évolutions du produit auprès des équipes internes, des clients et des partenaires
 Anticiper les risques, dépendances et contraintes liés à des systèmes industriels complexes, en s'appuyant sur les équipes techniques
 Structurer les processus de décision produit et favoriser une culture de collaboration, de responsabilisation et d’amélioration continue
 
 Profil :
 Vous êtes diplômé·e d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’une formation équivalente
 Vous disposez d’ au moins 10 ans d’expérience en Product Management , idéalement dans un environnement industriel, robotique, logiciel ou technologique complexe
 Vous avez une expérience significative dans la définition d’une vision produit et le pilotage d’une roadmap impliquant plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes
 Vous avez exercé un leadership reconnu dans des organisations matricielles, en donnant une direction claire à des équipes pluridisciplinaires et en créant l’alignement nécessaire à la réussite d’ambitions produit complexes
 Vous êtes à l’aise avec les problématiques mêlant hardware, software, robotique, automatisation et systèmes industriels
 Une expérience dans l’intralogistique, les entrepôts automatisés, les systèmes ASRS, la robotique mobile, le WCS ou le WES constitue un véritable atout
 Vous savez comprendre des sujets techniques complexes et les traduire en décisions produit claires et créatrices de valeur
 Vous êtes centré·e sur le client et appréciez le contact direct avec le terrain, les sites opérationnels et les équipes projet
 Vous possédez un esprit analytique et vous appuyez sur les données pour éclairer vos décisions
 Vous êtes capable d’arbitrer dans un environnement où les enjeux clients, business, techniques et opérationnels peuvent être contradictoires
 Vous disposez d’un excellent relationnel et d’un leadership naturel, vous permettant de fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires autour d’une ambition commune
 Vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre capacité à donner du sens, à faire grandir les équipes et à créer des conditions favorables à la prise de décision

jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internetâs largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 About the Team 

 Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

 But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

 The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

 The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

 This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.

 Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.

 Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.

 Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.

 Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.

 Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.

 Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.

 Identify and support new creator and developer categories

 Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.

 Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.

 Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more

 Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.
 Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.
 You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.
 
 About DataSnipper 
 The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.
 And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 
  
 
 What impact you will have 
 Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

 Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

 Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible
 

 Why it's an exciting challenge 
 Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

 Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

 Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

 Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.
 

 What you'll own 
 The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

 Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

 Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

 Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why
  

 What you'll do 
 Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

 Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

 Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

 Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.
 

 The Opportunity 

 As the Senior Manager of Product Structure, PLM & MES, you are the architect of the digital backbone that connects our robotic innovations to real-world production. In this high-impact leadership role, you will strategically own the implementation and evolution of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution (MES) systems and processes to scale with a rapidly growing product and manufacturing organization ("Digital Thread").
You will govern the product architecture for our complex mechatronic systems, ensuring that our Engineering BOM (EBOM), Manufacturing BOM (MBOM), and Service BOM (SBOM) are perfectly synchronized. 
This is not just a systems role — it’s a business transformation mandate. You will define and execute the PLM and MES roadmap in collaboration with executive stakeholders, ensuring alignment between engineering, operations, product, and after-sales service functions. You’ll help us build an integrated, enterprise-grade ecosystem that accelerates product development, enables traceability, and scales product data excellence.

 

 

 The Market & Our Technology 

 ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.

 Your Impact 

 Product Structure & Configuration Governance 

 BOM Mastery: Define and govern multi-level BOM structures for complex robotic systems, ensuring alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service. 

 Modular Architecture: Support platform-based development by managing product configurations, variants, and component reuse strategies. 

 Data Standards: Enforce rigorous part-numbering schemes, revision control, and BOM rules to maintain 100% data integrity.

 System Integration: Manage the technical "Digital Thread" between CAD → PLM → ERP → MES, ensuring real-time synchronization of product and manufacturing data. 

 Release Management: Oversee the lifecycle states, access controls, and workflows for all product releases and configuration baselines. 

 MES & Manufacturing Data Integration

 Process Definition: Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to define production routings, assembly sequences, and digital work instructions in the MES. 

 Traceability: Maintain "As-Built" traceability, ensuring consistency between MES production data and ERP production orders.

 Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in workflows to reduce NPI (New Product Introduction) cycle times and improve manufacturing scalability.
