jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Code Quality
jobs.description:
Position description 

 As Senior Product Manager for code quality, you’ll decide how 7 million developers find problems in their code as AI writes more of it. The gap is large: 96% of developers don’t fully trust AI-generated code, yet only 48% always check it before committing (Sonar State of Code, 2026). With the engineers who build our analyzers, you’ll shape what SonarQube detects across Cloud, Server and IDE, and how teams verify code written by agents. 

 

 
 The team: 

 
 You will join the Code Quality product team, part of Sonar's Product Management group. Each Code Quality PM works with dedicated engineering squads and partners closely with UX, marketing and sales. We value collaboration, kindness and continuous improvement, and we base decisions on data and customer evidence. 

 What will you own: 

 
 
 The strategy and roadmap to develop our language ecosystems, from market research and customer discovery to shipped rules and analyzers.

 
 Decisions on which new languages Sonar should support, and where we should not compete. 

 
 New AI capabilities: how our analysis fits into the workflows of AI coding agents, and how quality gates apply to AI-generated code. 

 
 Day-to-day trade-offs with analyzer engineers, such as rule precision versus noise, and analysis speed. 

 
 Regular contact with developers and customers through calls, our community forum and conferences, and turning what you learn into roadmap decisions. 

 

 What you will do 
 
 You’ll enjoy this role if you care about well-crafted software and like owning a topic end to end.

 

 
 Product vision and roadmap: research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities, and keep the roadmap effective

 
 Customer interaction: engage with users on the product forum, support them, and turn their feedback into opportunities

 
 Domain expertise: develop a deep understanding of code quality and how to help developers write more reliable, maintainable software

 
 Cross-team work: collaborate with other PMs on cross-product features, and align with engineering and UX from problem definition through development

 Experience and qualifications 
 
 Must-haves 

 
 5+ years in technical roles, ideally including hands-on software development. 

 
 3+ years as a product manager on a technical or B2B software product, owning discovery, strategy and roadmap rather than only the backlog, preferably in an agile environment. 

 
 Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in your own work, and an informed view of how they are changing software development. 

 
 Proven ability to lead a topic autonomously from start to finish, making pragmatic decisions amid change, complexity and uncertainty. 

 
 Fluent written and spoken English. 

 Nice to have 

 
 Solid understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem. 

 
 Technical understanding of how code scanning and static analysis tools work. 

 
 Experience in developer tools, or contributions to open-source tooling such as linters, compilers or IDE plugins. 

 
 Experience speaking or writing for developer audiences. 

 

 If you meet most of the must-haves and this work interests you, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn’t match every point. 

 Benefits of Working with Sonar: 

 We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 27 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.

 We contribute 60% of the total cost for your pension; 13.5% to 15.5% of your base salary for savings; 2% for risk.

 Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually. 

 Commuting:Sustainable mobility options, including carpooling and the refund of 60% of the annual transportation subscription.

 Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. 
 
 As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.
 
 Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.
 
 You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.
 
 No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.
 
 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 
 
 Responsibilities:
 Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

 Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases.

 Own product positioning, messaging and value propositions by developing clear, differentiated propositions per product line and segment, and translating technical capabilities into operational and commercial value for defense partners and clients.

 Support Product Management on pricing and packaging by providing market, competitor and customer insights for pricing decisions on products and end-to-end solutions, and aligning price positioning with Sales.

 Plan and execute product launches by introducing a launch process scaled to the size of each release, coordinating launch readiness across Product, Sales and Support, and providing product messaging, content and launch input to the Marketing team.

 Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Introductie 
 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?
 Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.
 We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.
 In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.
 
 Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.

 Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

 Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

 Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving
 

 Wat bieden wij 
 Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.
 Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring

Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The challenge 
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.
 These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.
 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.
 
 What you’ll do 
 Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

 Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

 Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

 Experiment fast: Ship small bets, A/B test the journeys that matter, observe real world behaviour and turn results into roadmap decisions.

 Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

 AI-native execution: Use AI across discovery, specs, analysis and prototyping, and help shape how the team builds with AI.

 Partner across the business: Work with Revenue, Marketing, Support and Data on go-to-market, acquisition, retention and the metrics that show we're winning.

 
 
 The Team 
 You'll join a lean Product & Engineering team where product, design, mobile, web, backend, VoIP and QA work closely together. No silos, no layers: turn a customer insight on Monday into a live experiment by Friday.
 
 What you’ll bring 
 5+ years in product management, including owning a product line or new proposition end to end.

 A track record of scaling a product from early traction, with commercial results to show.

 Hands-on experience with B2B, SMB or prosumer products; telecoms is a plus.

 Strong discovery skills: customer interviews, research synthesis and jobs-to-be-done thinking.

 Experimentation fluency: A/B testing, product analytics (Mixpanel or similar) and data analysis and data-driven decision making.

 Experience optimising MAU, ARPU, LTV, retention and conversion, with the business acumen to make strategic and tactical calls.

 Experience leading agile, cross-functional mobile product teams, with the technical depth to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

 Active, daily use of AI across your product workflow: research, analysis, specs and prototyping.

 
Who you are 
 Growth mindset: You're energised by building a playbook that doesn't exist yet.

 Ambitious and pragmatic: You aim for 100 but ship the smallest thing that proves the next step.

 Owner: You act without waiting for permission and own outcomes, not output.

 Customer-obsessed: You'd rather talk to five customers than debate one assumption.

 Clear communicator: You align engineers, leadership and partners around one simple story.

 Comfortable with ambiguity: You make good calls on imperfect data and kill what isn't working, even your own ideas.

 You're based in or moving to The Netherlands and can be in our office three days a week.

 
Recruitment process 
 First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

 Hiring manager interview: A deep dive into your experience with our Head of Product.

 Case study: Present a practical Calling for Work challenge to the team at our office.

 Meet the CEO. 

 Reference check 

 Offer 

 
 What You Get 
 Competitive compensation 
 77,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

 Learning and growth 
 €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

 Time to recharge 
 25 vacation days 

 Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

 Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) 

 Work from anywhere 
 As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

 A team you’ll actually want to be part of 
 Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

 Regular team moments and outings 

 An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

 Set up for success 
 Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

 Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager II
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Axon's mission is simple and bold: Protect Life.

We build technology that helps first responders, security teams and communities act with speed, clarity and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security and international agencies detect, assess and respond to threats.

Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors and location data into a unified operating picture, and the map is where that picture comes together. It shows where every officer, vehicle, camera, drone and sensor is, what state it is in, and what is happening around it. We're building a map that stays clear under pressure, so operators and responders can see what matters and act in seconds.

Your Impact

As Senior Product Manager for Maps & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus shows the world in real time. You'll own the live map, floor plans and the presence layer: the "dots on the map" that tell operators who and what is where, and whether that information is fresh.

You'll own the map experience operators use every shift and the map services every other team builds on. Your work will let any device, sensor or data source appear on the map in a consistent way, without bespoke work for each one. That spans body cameras, fleet vehicles, drones, CCTV, sensors and third-party devices, indoors and outdoors.

You'll also lead the map in Axon's next generation of Fusus: role-based experiences built from shared components, where every role gets a map designed for its job. Your work will help responders find the nearest resource, follow an incident as it moves and reconstruct what happened afterwards, directly advancing Axon's mission to Protect Life.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Maps & Presence product roadmap, focused on a map that is clear, consistent and fast to act from
  • Define one behavior model for every real-time dot on the map (how each device type looks, clusters, shows state and freshness) and retire legacy formats
  • Own the map services and contracts (layers, geo-boundaries, floor plans, the Presence API) that let other teams put new data on the map through self-service
  • Build self-service floor plans and map layers for customer admins, so setup no longer depends on Support or Professional Services
  • Lead the map and floor-plan components for Fusus's role-based experiences, shipping them in today's Fusus first
  • Deliver location history (breadcrumbs) and cross-camera tracking for investigations, with Search and video teams
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency and reliable map experiences across web and mobile
  • Engage law enforcement and enterprise users in real-time crime centers and the field to validate needs and test improvements
  • Use metrics and feedback to set priorities: dot freshness, map load time, presence coverage, time from alert to action
  • Support go-to-market, training and rollout with cross-functional teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Operators trust what they see on the map: every device looks and behaves the same way, and stale data is obvious
  • New devices and data sources appear on the map in days, without map-team engineering work
  • Customers set up their own floor plans and layers, and filter the map to what matters to them
  • Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention and positive field feedback
  • Every second saved contributes to safer outcomes for officers, teams and the public

What You Bring

  • 6–8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on map-based, location or real-time products<

jobs.title: Product Manager - Business Processes
jobs.description:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 

As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. 

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cato Networks is building Product-Led Growth capabilities that complement its established enterprise, direct-sales, and partner-led business.

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product-led customer journeys across Cato’s target markets, with a particular focus on SMB while also improving how larger enterprise customers discover, evaluate, activate, adopt, and expand Cato.

For SMB customers, this may include highly self-service journeys from signup and onboarding through value realization, purchase, and expansion. For larger enterprises, PLG will complement the sales-led motion by helping customers experience value sooner, adopt more effectively, identify expansion opportunities, and create stronger product-qualified demand.

This is an individual-contributor role. You will own measurable customer and business outcomes, working directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Business Operations.

What You’ll Do 

  • Own and improve the end-to-end PLG journey across relevant customer segments: discover → evaluate → activate → experience value → adopt → convert → retain → expand.
  • Define segment-specific product-led journeys for SMB and enterprise customers, balancing self-service, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted experiences.
  • For SMB, drive simple self-service onboarding, guided configuration, sensible defaults, in-product education, packaging, upgrade paths, and purchase experiences.
  • For enterprise customers, identify ways to accelerate evaluation, activation, time-to-value, adoption, product-qualified demand, and expansion.
  • Define the key activation and “aha” moments for different customer segments, and improve time-to-first-value and unassisted or assisted activation.
  • Own product requirements related to trials, free experiences where relevant, packaging, entitlements, upgrade paths, pricing UX, purchase flows, and conversion triggers.
  • Define, instrument, and monitor PLG metrics, including activation, time-to-first-value, product adoption, conversion, product-qualified opportunities, retention, and expansion.
  • Use product analytics, customer research, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, test hypotheses, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Finance, and Business Operations to create seamless product-led, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted journeys.
  • Identify product-usage and behavioral signals that can trigger contextual recommendations, expansion opportunities, partner engagement, or sales outreach. 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS.

jobs.title: PROJECT MANAGER – AI-FIRST DELIVERY (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle Wir suchen erfahrene Verstärkung, die Projekte verlässlich ins Ziel bringt und dafür sorgt, dass aus einem guten Plan funktionierende Software wird. Als Project Manager bei Turbine Kreuzberg steuerst du Kundenprojekte vom Business Intent bis zur produktiven Software. Du hältst Scope, Budget und Termine, sorgst dafür, dass das Team immer an dem arbeitet, was für den Kunden gerade am meisten zählt, und setzt AI dabei so selbstverständlich ein wie Backlog und Budgetplan. 
 Intern führst du integrierte Teams aus Consultants, Engineers und Designer:innen fachlich durch das Projekt, Seite an Seite mit unseren Technical Directors. Beim Kunden sind Fachbereichs- und IT-Verantwortliche dein Gegenüber, intern hast du einen direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 
 Du bindest AI-Tooling tief in deinen Arbeitsalltag ein, verstehst, wie Entwicklungsteams heute mit Agentic Engineering liefern, und planst Projekte so, dass diese Geschwindigkeit beim Kunden ankommt – mit menschlicher Verantwortung für Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse. Ganz nach unserem Leitmotiv: »From Intent to Code«. 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Projektverantwortung:  Du planst und steuerst Kundenprojekte end-to-end. Scope, Budget, Termine und Qualität liegen bei dir, von der Beauftragung bis zur Abnahme, im Festpreis genauso wie in Time & Material. 

 Anforderungen & Backlog:  Du klärst mit dem Kunden Anforderungen und Prioritäten, übersetzt den Business Intent in einen klaren Backlog. 

 Projektsteuerung : Du behältst Umfang, Aufwand, Budget und Termine aktiv im Blick und greifst ein, bevor Abweichungen zum Problem werden. Du erkennst Veränderungen frühzeitig, stellst sie transparent vor und schlägst einen passenden Weg vor: Change Request, Nachbeauftragung oder Re-Priorisierung. 

 Projektcontrolling:  Du verantwortest Budget-Forecast und Abrechnung mit dem Kunden sowie Vorbereitung und Moderation der monatlichen Steering Meetings. 

 Stakeholder Management:  Du bist im Projektalltag die zentrale Ansprechperson für den Kunden und managst Erwartungen, Risiken und Eskalationen 

 AI-basierte Delivery:  Du setzt AI täglich ein, etwa für Anforderungsdokumentation, Meeting-Zusammenfassungen, Status-Reports, Risikoanalysen, Prototypen und Testfälle, und zeigst Team und Kunden, was davon im Projekt wirklich trägt. 

 Account-Entwicklung:  Du erkennst Potenziale für Folgevorhaben und entwickelst den Account auch strategisch weiter. 

 Mitgestalten:  Du prägst mit, wie Projektmanagement in einer AI-first-Organisation aussieht: Prozesse, Templates, Tooling und das Zusammenspiel mit Agentic Engineering. 

 

 Was du mitbringst Erfahrung:  Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder als Product Owner in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mehrere Jahre mit Kundenprojekten in einer Digitalagentur, Technologieberatung oder einem Softwareunternehmen. 

 Ownership:  Erfahrung mit Projekten mit festem Scope und festen Terminen und ein sicheres Gespür dafür, wann ein Projekt aus dem Ruder zu laufen beginnt. 

 Requirements:  Die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen so zu formulieren, dass Engineers damit bauen können, und nach Geschäftswert zu priorisieren. 

 Tech-Verständnis:  Ein fundiertes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung, von Architekturen und Schnittstellen über Cloud bis zu agiler Lieferung. Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du verstehst, worüber dein Team spricht. 

 Zahlenverständnis:  Du kalkulierst Budgets, behältst die Marge im Blick und erklärst Forecasts so, dass der Kunde jede Zahl nachvollziehen kann. 

 AI-Praxis:  KI ist für dich selbstverständlich: Du nutzt Assistenten, Agents und Automatisierungstools täglich, baust dir eigene Workflows und weißt aus Erfahrung, wo AI im Projektalltag trägt und wo nicht. 

 Kommunikation:  Die Souveränität, Steering Meetings mit Bereichsleitungen genauso zu moderieren wie Refinements und Workshops mit dem Team. 

 Sprache: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (mind. C1). 

 

 Das erwartet dich bei uns Gestaltungsspielraum:  Du prägst mit, wie Projektmanagement bei Turbine aussieht. 

 Kurze Wege:  Du hast einen direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Langfristige Projekte:  Unsere Auftraggeber setzen auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit und erwarten strategische Impulse von dir. 

 Starke Teams:  Du bringst mit erfahrenen Consultants, Engineers, Architekt:innen und den Teams unserer Auftraggeber Projekte sicher ins Ziel bringst. 

 Zwei plus drei:  Hybrides Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen im Office in Berlin und drei Tagen flexibel. 

 Frischer Wind für deine Ideen:  In unseren Breakout- und Hackout-Sessions entwickelst du neue Ideen und testest neue Wege. 

 Meerblick statt Bürowand:  Pack deinen Laptop ein und arbeite eine Zeit lang aus unserer Agentur-Wohnung in Faro, Portugal. 

 Wachse über dich hinaus:  Wir geben dir Zeit und Budget für deine persönliche Weiterbildung. 

 Fit bleiben, wie du willst:  Wir bezuschussen deine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club 

 Ex

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Lead 
 Reporting to: CMO
 Location: London (hybrid, 4 days a week in the office)
 Salary: £80,000-£100,000 + equity
 About Electric Twin 
 Most organisations make their biggest decisions on a thin slice of evidence - a handful of customer calls, one survey, instinct when the data runs out. Electric Twin changes that. We build synthetic audiences: simulations of real groups of people, grounded in research data. Teams ask them questions, test ideas and explore how people might respond, and get answers in minutes that would otherwise take weeks.
 The work is grounded, and the science is real. We've run over 40,000 evaluations across populations covering 155 countries. Independent academic research with Professor Michael Muthukrishna at the LSE found our outputs come back roughly 10,000x faster than traditional methods, at 95% accuracy. Customers including The Times, Sage, Virgin, Vodafone and Wingstop use Electric Twin to bring customer insight into decisions about campaigns, products, pricing and strategy.
 Electric Twin was founded by Dr Ben Warner (former Chief Data Advisor to the UK Prime Minister) and our CEO, Alex Cooper (a former senior military commander and Director of Mass Covid Testing in the pandemic). We're backed by Atomico, LocalGlobe, Mercuri and angels including Marc Andreessen. We're a team of engineers, AI researchers, behavioural scientists and operators - careful with the science, careful with the responsibility.
 The role 
 We're hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own product marketing at Electric Twin, from the strategy through to the sales deck.
 Our ambition is to make understanding people a normal part of making decisions. Product marketing is central to that. It's how we decide who Electric Twin is for, what we compete against and why a buyer should choose us, and how that story reaches the market through our product, our website and our sales team.
 Next year is a big one. We're launching in new markets, taking Electric Twin to more parts of a business, and bringing more products to market. We need someone who has operated at this level before, and who can join the dots between sales, marketing and product.
 Product marketing here covers four areas: insights, storytelling, go-to-market and enablement. You'll own all four, and decide where to lean in as the company grows.
 You'll work closely with our CMO, our VP Product and our sales team. Our Growth Lead runs the engine - the channels and programmes that reach and convert our audience. Product marketing and content provide the fuel. You'll own positioning and messaging. Our Content Lead will turn it into stories and get them out across every channel.
 This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, and you'll also write the launch plan, the value proposition brief and the sales deck yourself.

What’s exciting - you’re the founding PMM and get to build out and lead this function as we expand.
 What you'll do 
 Insights 
 Be the expert on our customer. We have strong customer research, a map of what customers want to use the product for and a regular round-up of the questions they ask. Build on it, keep it current and make sure the rest of the business uses it.

 Understand the buyers we're growing into. Our buyer today is the insights team. Marketing, product and commercial teams come next. Speak to them, define who they are and work out what they need to hear from us.

 Know the market. This is a fast-moving category, with research incumbents launching their own products and a new batch of innovators arriving. Track it, and keep a clear, committed point of view on how Electric Twin is different.

 Bring an opinion to product strategy. Work with our VP Product on the value proposition, and bring the customer and the market into decisions about what we build.

 Storytelling 
 Own our positioning and messaging. Keep one consistent way of describing what Electric Twin is, who it is for and why a buyer should choose it, used by sales, product and marketing.

 Own the trust story. Trust is central to how buyers choose us. Own how we prove it: the evidence, the customer stories and the guidance for prospects who want to evaluate us for themselves.

 Turn the product into language a buyer would use. Take what we build and describe it in the customer's words, across the website, the product and our sales materials.

 Shape the story for new markets and buyers. Build and adjust the narrative for our new market launches, and for the teams beyond insight and research that we want to reach.

 Go-to-market 
 Set the product narrative. Agree a product narrative each quarter with our VP Product, so every launch adds up to a bigger story.

 Run our launches. Build a tiered launch process so the effort matches the size of the release, and run it with product, sales and marketing.

 Take Electric Twin to new buyers and markets. Plan how we go to market in the US, in new verticals and with new teams inside our customers.

 Improve

About Lendable
 Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

 Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 
 In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.
 A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.
 If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.
 
 About the role 
 We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.
 No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.
 
 What you'll work on 
 Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

 Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

 Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

 Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

 Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

 Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team
 

 What we're looking for 
 Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.
 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

 You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

 You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

 You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

 You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

 You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

 You like days that look different from each other

 Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

 Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.
 
 AI at Lendable 
 We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to product

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex 
 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 
 💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience 
  
 Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.
  
 Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.
  
 We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.
  
 If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.
 At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

 Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

 We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

  
 Here's what you can expect to be working on 
 Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

 Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

 Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

 Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

 Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

  
 You should apply if: 
 You’re curious about how AI is changing product design and you already use it in your own work. You’re comfortable designing features that use it, without needing deep specialist experience.

 You’ve got a well-formed point of view on building trust into a product - how you design for transparency and control, how you handle edge cases and errors, and how you make sure users always feel in charge.

 You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

 You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

 You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

  
 You probably shouldn't apply if: 
 Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

 You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

 You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

 You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

  
 A bit about you 
 Complex product experience:: Complex product experience: You’ve designed for complex, data-heavy or technical products, with real examples of how you made them simple and trustworthy for users.

 Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

 Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

 Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

 Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

 Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

 Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

Who Are We ? 
 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. 
 Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.
 At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.
 Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.
 We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 
 💼 About This Role 
 As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It’s a role with real ownership, where your decisions matter and you can see their impact directly in the product.
 🎖 What Success Looks Like 
 In your first month 
 You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

 You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

 You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

 You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

 By 3 months 
 You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

 You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

 You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

 You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

 You work with the relevant team members to ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

 You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

 You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

 You will have ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

 By 6 months 
 You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

 You have ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

 You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

 You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

 You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

 You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

 You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful 
 You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

 You bring several years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment.

 You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

 You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

 You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

 You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

 You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

 You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

 You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

 This role is based in our Munich or Nuremberg office, with at least 3 days per week on site.
 ⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies 
 You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

 You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

 You have experience working with CRM systems.

 💡It’s a Plus If You Have 
 Previous experience in the logistics industry.

 Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful 
 At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company’s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai
  • You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation
  • You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives
  • You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators
  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

jobs.description:
Level Up Your Career! 

 

 At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

 

 At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5.
 

 
 Join The Team! 

 Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

 You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better. 

 We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

 
This role is based onsite 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. 

 What You’ll Do: 
 

 Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.

 Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.

 Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.

 Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.

 Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.

 Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.

 Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

 What You’ll Own: 
 
 Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

 You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

 How we’ll celebrate your success: 

 Growth in LTV and profit from product changes.

 Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games.

 Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped.

 Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions.

 What We’re Looking For: 
 Essential 

 Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.

 Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.

 A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.

 Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads.

 A clear, warm communicator who makes the case to players and pounds.

 Desirable 

 SQL experience.

 Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.

 Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience.

 Why Kwalee? 

 
 Generous Holiday: Start with 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!

 Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.

 Health Cover: Private medical cover, life assurance, a solid pension plan, and cover for dental and optical care.

 Recharge: Take advantage of our on-site gym and a supportive atmosphere that prioritises your wellbeing.

 Free Food & Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.

 Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!

 Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your furry friend to our vibrant, fun office.

jobs.description:
As a AI Product Manager at Reonic , you’ll own product problems from discovery through execution.
 You’ll work closely with customers, product, design, and engineering to understand what users need, define the right solutions, and bring them to life. A strong focus of your role will be shaping the UX and UI of our product — from improving existing workflows to designing entirely new experiences.
 You’ll combine product thinking with a strong eye for design, constantly asking: What problem are we solving, for whom, and how can we make the experience as simple and valuable as possible? 
 You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to directly shape how the product looks, feels, and works.
 Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg. 
 
 What you'll do 
 Own product problems end-to-end: Take ownership of product areas from discovery and problem definition through prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration.

 Shape the user experience: Design intuitive, efficient, and delightful experiences across the product. Turn complex workflows into simple solutions that users can understand and adopt quickly.

 Understand our users: Talk to customers, analyze feedback and usage data, identify pain points, and develop a deep understanding of how renewable installers work.

 Think beyond the brief: Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was initially requested.

 Design and prototype: Work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and UI concepts to explore solutions quickly. Iterate with users and the team before investing heavily in development.

 Set the UX/UI bar: Maintain a high standard for usability, consistency, accessibility, and visual quality across the product.

 Balance user and business needs: Make thoughtful product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and available data.

 Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the product development process, communicate requirements clearly, and make pragmatic decisions when trade-offs arise.

 Iterate after launch: Treat shipping as the beginning, not the end. Measure outcomes, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product experience.

 Leverage AI in your workflow: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and product development.

 
 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 Product experience: 2+ years of experience in product management, product design, UX/UI, or a similar product-focused role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing product environment.

 Strong product sense: You naturally think about customer problems, business impact, and outcomes rather than simply features and output.

 UX/UI expertise: You have a strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and usability. You care deeply about how a product feels to use.

 Hands-on approach: You’re comfortable getting into Figma, creating wireframes and prototypes, testing ideas, and iterating on designs yourself.

 Customer obsession: You enjoy talking to users and can translate qualitative feedback and observed behavior into clear product opportunities.

 Comfort with ambiguity: You can take an unclear problem, structure it, identify what matters, and move towards a solution without needing every detail defined upfront.

 Strong communication: You can clearly explain product decisions, design rationale, and trade-offs to engineers, designers, leadership, and other stakeholders.

 Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions, and follow problems through from initial idea to measurable impact.

 Technical curiosity: You enjoy working closely with engineers and are interested in understanding the technical constraints and possibilities behind the products you build.

 AI-native mindset: You’re curious about how AI can improve both the products we build and the way we build them.

  
 Why Join Us? 
 Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

 A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers , giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

 High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

 Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

 A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a AI Product Manager at Reonic , you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and our customers.
 You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process.
 You’ll have a lot of ownership and work closely with engineers and other teams to improve both our product and the way we build and release it.
 Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg. 
 
 What you'll do 
 Prioritize AI product improvements based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and data.

 AI-Savviness: Stay up to date with developments in generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and related technologies and identify relevant opportunities for Reonic.

 Own release testing: Coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and provide clear, actionable feedback to engineering.

 Coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams.

 Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience.

 Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate issues, reproduce problems, and translate findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering.

 Communicate what's new: Create release notes, run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works.

 Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers.

 Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to make better product decisions.

 
 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 Product mindset: You naturally think beyond checklists. You want to understand why something is being built, who it is for, and what makes it useful.

 Attention to detail: You spot inconsistencies, edge cases, and potential issues before they become customer problems.

 Strong communication: You can clearly communicate with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders. Professional fluency in English (C2) is required.

 Technical curiosity: You enjoy understanding how software works and aren't afraid to dig into technical details, investigate bugs, or learn new concepts.

 Customer orientation: You care about the experience of the people using the product and can turn qualitative feedback into actionable insights.

 Ownership: You take responsibility, follow things through, and don't wait for someone else to solve a problem that you can help solve yourself.

 Startup mindset: You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and processes are still being built.

 Relevant experience: Experience in product management, product operations, QA, software development, B2B SaaS, or a similar role is a plus. A degree in economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field is also helpful, but not required.

 
 Why Join Us? 
 Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

 A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers , giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

 High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

 Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

 A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

 Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

 Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.

 
 Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all.
 
 About Reonic 
 At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.
 Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.
 Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.
 
 Location
 This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg. 
 
 Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Dach (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

 
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 
 About the Role 
 You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our Munich office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in Germany and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

 Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

 Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

 Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.
  

 What You Bring 
 Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

 Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

 Native level german speaking.

 Bonus Points 
 Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

 Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

 Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

 Experience working with platform or API products

 Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

 Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

 
 Location 
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Munich office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.
