jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
jobs.description:
Who we are 
 
 Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.
 
 We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.
 
 As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.
 
 We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.
 
 Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!
 About this role
 
At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.
 We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale . You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.
 You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.
 This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.
 To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.
 

 Your responsibilities
 Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

 Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

 Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

 Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

 Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

 Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

 Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

 Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

 

 Tools we use
 Amplitude, SQL, Looker

 Figma

 Notion

 Slack

 Enterpret

 AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust
 

 Who you are
 You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

 You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

 You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

 You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

 You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

 You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

 You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

 You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

 You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

 Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus
 

 Within a month, you will
 Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

 Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

 Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiment

jobs.title: Product Manager, Platform (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
 We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

 The Opportunity 
 As a Product Manager in the Platform team, you own our established booking API, used by all our clients for booking and post-sales actions. You extend its functionality to match the market, build new capabilities on top of our wealth of data, and make the API as easy as possible to use and understand, so new clients can get started faster. 
 
 What you will do: 

 Product Ownership & Strategy: Own the product end-to-end, shaping its roadmap and priorities for booking and post-sales functionality, and working autonomously within the team’s direction. 

 API Evolution: Extend booking and post-sales capabilities to match market standards, and build new features on top of our established API. 

 Integration Experience: Make the API simple to understand and use, with clear contracts, documentation, and flows that shorten onboarding for new customers. 

 Complex Solution Design: Design end-to-end solutions across multiple systems and workflows, working with engineering on system design for high-load environments. 

 Quality & Reliability: Make sure the product is robust and error-resistant, with every relevant use case and edge case covered. 

 Data-Driven Initiatives: Use our booking data and research to find opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and measure impact. 

 Stakeholder Alignment: Align retailers, carriers, engineering, commercial, and operations teams around clear priorities and outcomes. 

 
 Workplace: 
 We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin.
 We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.

 
 Who you are: 
 2+ years of product management experience, with a strong focus on B2B and technical products. 

 Hands-on AI experience and the ambition to make it core to how you work, shipping faster without compromising quality.

 Proven experience owning API products end-to-end, from contract design to customer adoption. 

 Solid understanding of system design and high-load, transactional systems; able to discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers. 

 A track record of independently leading complex product initiatives with multiple stakeholders. 

 Strong attention to detail and design thinking, especially for complex workflows and edge cases. 

 A data-driven, impact-focused mindset, using data and research to shape decisions. 

 Excellent communication skills in English. 
 Nice to Have 

 Experience with ticket-selling, booking, or auction systems. 

 Background in travel, mobility, or marketplace platforms. 
 

 What you can expect: 
 You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.

 You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company.

 We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.

 You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

 For Management positions: As part of the management team, you will shape our strategy and organization beyond your area of responsibility.

 You will join an international team of talented, driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

 We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company.

 

 Our hiring process for this role: 
 Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Anh Do and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Jorien Knipping.
For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at ( Come join us!

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager Dual Use In-Orbit Services
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.
 
At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, humans. Nyx is being developed with the capabilities required for safe, reliable and repeatable rendezvous, proximity operations and docking, including missions to the International Space Station.

 Building on this heritage, our Future Projects activities are developing new orbital services and spacecraft applications for institutional, commercial and defence customers. We are seeking an experienced Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager to lead the complete development and delivery of orbiters for defence and dual-use applications.

 This is a high-impact role for an experienced spacecraft project manager who can translate customer needs into executable programmes and lead multidisciplinary teams from early concept and proposal phases through design, qualification, launch, commissioning and operations. The successful candidate will combine strong spacecraft engineering understanding with a proven record of delivering flight hardware and managing demanding institutional and defence stakeholders.

 Key Responsibilities

 In your capacity as Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager, your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day your duties will include:

 Lead the complete development of orbiters and associated in-orbit service capabilities for defence and dual-use missions, from mission definition and early concept studies through qualification, launch, commissioning, flight and operations.

 Translate customer objectives and operational needs into clear mission, system and programme requirements.

 Establish and maintain the project baseline, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, technical performance and quality objectives.

 Define the project organisation, work breakdown structure, milestones, reviews and decision gates.

 Drive disciplined decision-making, issue resolution and change control throughout the project lifecycle.

 Ensure successful delivery against commitments in terms of technical performance, schedule, cost, quality and customer satisfaction.

 Monitor industrialisation, procurement, manufacturing and supply-chain activities, ensuring that critical path items and long-lead equipment are actively managed.

 Work closely with engineering and industrial teams to ensure the timely delivery of flight and ground hardware, software, documentation and operational products

 Act as the main point of contact for institutional and defence customers throughout the project lifecycle.

 Support and lead the preparation of proposals, responses to Invitations to Tender, Requests for Proposals and other business opportunities related to defence and dual-use in-orbit services.

 Coordinate and lead multidisciplinary teams across programme management, systems engineering, spacecraft engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, quality and business functions.

 What We Would Love to See from You

 In the role of Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager, ideally, you will have the following:
 Master’s degree in aerospace engineering.

 Typically 10 or more years of professional experience in the aerospace or space sector, including substantial responsibility for project or programme management and technical delivery.

 Proven experience leading the end-to-end development of satellites, orbiters, spacecraft or complex space systems.

 Demonstrated delivery of flight hardware, including experience through integration and test, qualification, launch preparation and/or in-orbit operations.

 Established customer-facing experience, ideally including direct interaction with DLR, the German Federal Ministry of Defence or comparable institutional and defence organisations.

 Skills and Behaviors

 Fluency in English and German.

 Strong oral and written communication skills

 Strong analysis and problem-solving skills

 Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks

 Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

 Ability to communicate at all levels of the business

 Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork

 Space enthusiast: ready to change the global space industry

  
 Why you should join us! 
 What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  
 We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

 We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

 We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

 We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.
 
 To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:

 Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.

 Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.

 Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.
 

 ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE
 Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.

 Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.

 Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.
 

 PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY
 Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.

 Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.

 Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.
 

 PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP
 Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs.

 Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage.

 Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication.

 Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped complex technical products in enterprise environments and can point to lessons learned that shaped your craft.

 Strong developer empathy: You understand how engineering teams build, test, version, deploy, and operate software in production.

 Thrive in ambiguity: You bring structure to fuzzy technical problems and prioritize clearly across many possible directions.

 Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information.

 Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan.

 Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Connect (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare! 
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam.
 Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows.
 
 What you'll do 
 As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business.
 Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 
 Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect , identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value

 Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights

 Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals

 Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network

 Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets

 
 Who you are 
 Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions!
 
 You could be our next team mate if you: 
 Have 4+ years of Product Management experience, including at least 1 year working on mobile applications, with a track record of shipping products that have delivered meaningful business results and proven user value

 Have experience developing SaaS or mobile products, ideally including a network effect component such as social networking, communication services, or collaborative workplace tools

 Approach problems with an analytical mindset, balancing quantitative and qualitative insights to make data-informed decisions

 Communicate with clarity and conviction to align diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, driving vision and articulating user value and business impact

 Are highly organised and disciplined in project management, with strong attention to detail and the confidence to ask tough questions and say no when needed

 

 Now, it would be fantastic if you: 
 Have experience with health tech, marketplace, or platform products

 Are familiar with operating in multi-market environments

 Have worked in a scale-up or fast-paced product organisation

 Our AI vision 
 We believe in the responsible use of AI to improve healthcare. Find out more about our approach here .
 
 What we offer: 
 Company pension scheme through our partner Allianz

 27 days of annual leave per year (and the ability to accrue more days on your work anniversary!)

 Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care 

 Free breakfast and lunch plan every day on-site

 Bike lease scheme with our partner Lease a Bike, 35% price below the market

 Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

 Discounted membership with Urban Sports Club

 Continuous training programs on all key competencies (English, soft skills, expertise)

 Reimbursement of public transportation if you live outside the Amsterdam highway ring

 Parent Care Program: Various initiatives supporting parenthood, including 100% paid parental leave up to 16 weeks, including bonuses, for mothers and up to 5 weeks for the co-parent, flexible return and 3 days of leave per year for child sickness

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - France
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

 
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 
 About the Role 
 You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.
 
This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

 Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

 Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

 Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

 Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

 Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

 Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

 Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

 Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.
 

 What You Bring 
 Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

 Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

 Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

 Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

 Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

 A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

 Native level french speaking.

 Bonus Points 
 Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

 Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

 Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

 Experience working with platform or API products

 Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

 Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

 
 Location 
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.
 
 How to Apply 
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

 Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

 Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

 Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Inference
jobs.description:
About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 
 The role 
 Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud. Our inference platform already serves production traffic at scale. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own the inference portfolio within our Cloud & Inference organization.
 You'll set strategy, write specs, sit with customers running production traffic, and work across our inference, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams to deliver real customer impact. Example problems you may work on include figuring out the next inference product we should launch to help our customers scale their AI workloads or how we cut fraudulent free-tier usage without adding friction for legitimate users.
 You will work on state of the art infrastructure, in close collaboration with our science and research engineering teams. Your job is to turn that infrastructure into products that AI-native startups and enterprises pay for, integrated with our developer platform Studio.
 You will operate as an individual contributor first — taking end-to-end ownership of complex and significant product lines — while building the foundation for the inference PM team as the portfolio grows. The size and shape of the team reporting into the role will be defined together with the VP Product once you're in place; from day one the expectation is hands-on product leadership, not people management.
 You will be the first PM fully dedicated to inference and the most senior product hire in the space. You will report to the VP Product - Cloud & Inference, and work day-to-day with our inference engineering teams in the US and Europe.
 
 What you'll do 
 Strategy and vision: define the vision, strategy, and annual goals for the inference portfolio, aligned with customer needs and company objectives. Benchmark the managed-inference field and pick where we win.

 Roadmap and execution: own the full lifecycle for serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, and adjacent services. Prioritize, ship, measure, iterate. Economics: own adoption, revenue contribution, and gross margin for your products. Treat cost-per-token, unit economics, and capacity tradeoffs as product decisions, and partner with GTM, Finance and Marketing on pricing, packaging, and launches.

 Customers: spend real time with AI-native startups and enterprises running advanced production workloads. Turn their constraints, like latency, throughput, compliance, and cost, into roadmap choices.

 Engineering partnership: work daily with inference engineering and the cloud infrastructure teams behind our data centers on capacity planning, scheduling, routing, and reliability.

 Research and open source: track open-source inference advances and emerging model architectures, and turn them into performance and efficiency gains for the product.

 Team building: as the portfolio scales, help shape and grow the inference PM team — hiring, mentoring, and setting the product bar.

 
 What we're looking for 
 Deep product experience in tech and infrastructure with a track record of bringing inference, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale distributed systems to market. You have built robust, at-scale AI infrastructure first-hand.

 An engineering background before moving into product management.

 You have taken an infra or inference product from early stage to material revenue and adoption, owning complex and significant product lines end to end.

 Player-coach disposition: you lead from the front — hands-on product work now, with the range and appetite to build and coach a team as we scale.

 Fluency in the economics of the business: gross margin, unit economics, and the tradeoffs behind token pricing and GPU capacity.

 High ownership and a strong bias for action. You prototype with AI coding tools, write your own specs, and unblock yourself without waiting for engineers or designers.

 Low ego, comfort in ambiguity, and credibility with executives, engineers, and customers alike.

 
 What We Offer 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic Safety
jobs.description:
About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 
 The Role 
 Mistral AI provides full-stack AI solutions, from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute, used by developers, enterprises, and public institutions worldwide. We are a dynamic, creative, low-ego team distributed across Europe, North America, Asia, and the Middle East, passionate about AI's potential to transform society.
 As our models and products reach millions of people and power increasingly critical workloads across enterprises and public institutions, safety is becoming an essential product challenge.
 We are looking for our first Product Manager, Agentic Safety to own this space end-to-end, translating safety research and policy into concrete, user-facing product behaviors across our API platform and product surfaces.
 You will define which guardrails should be enabled by default, what controls customers should have, and how we measure and communicate residual risk. Working at the intersection of Product, Research, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Security, you will shape how safety is built into our products, balancing protection, usability, and customer needs.
 This is a unique opportunity to build a new product function from the ground up and directly influence how frontier AI is deployed responsibly at scale.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Safety Product Strategy 
 Own the Safety roadmap across Mistral's API platform and products, including Vibe and Studio, from strategy through to product behavior and delivery.

 Define the product vision and priorities for safety features, guardrails, controls, and safeguards.

 Translate safety research and policy requirements into practical product capabilities that customers can understand, configure, and trust.

 Determine which safety mechanisms should be enabled by default and where customers should have flexibility and control.

 Safety Measurement and Evaluation 
 Define how safety is measured across our products, including evaluations, residual risk, precision and coverage trade-offs, and emerging harm trends.

 Establish clear metrics and take accountability for tracking and improving safety performance.

 Work closely with Research and Engineering teams to translate evaluation results into actionable product improvements.

 Ensure safety considerations are embedded in feature launches and deployment decisions through a safety-by-design approach.

 Incident Management and Continuous Improvement 
 Lead Safety incident response and post-incident reviews.

 Turn safety events, emerging risks, and customer feedback into concrete product improvements.

 Establish processes to identify, assess, and mitigate safety risks across our products.

 Continuously assess the effectiveness of existing safeguards and identify opportunities to strengthen them.

 Cross-Functional Leadership and External Representation 
 Partner closely with Policy, Legal, Research, Engineering, Security, and Operations to drive safety initiatives across the organization.

 Align and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver safety improvements without compromising product velocity or customer trust.

 Represent Mistral on Safety product topics in discussions with customers and regulators.

 Communicate complex safety decisions, trade-offs, and residual risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Several years of experience in Product Management, with meaningful exposure to Safety, platform integrity, abuse prevention, or AI safety.

jobs.title: Product Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Product Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände 
 80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
 Über MaxBrain 
 MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände.
 Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr.
 

 Worum es geht 
 Lernen ist für uns kein Pflichtprogramm. Lernen ist ein Motor für Entwicklung, Performance und Kultur.
 Unsere Vision: MaxBrain wird die People-Development-Plattform für mittelständische Unternehmen. Das Fundament steht: geschäftskritische Lern-Ökosysteme für Bildungsinstitute und Verbände. Darauf bauen wir auf. Künftig bildet MaxBrain nicht nur Lernmassnahmen ab, sondern auch die Prozesse, die bestimmen, wer was, wann und weshalb lernt: Skill Management, Performance Management, Compliance, Onboarding und Karrierepfade. KI ist dabei kein Zusatzmodul, sondern unterstützt in jedem Schritt: beim Finden passender Inhalte, beim Abgleich von Skills und bei Lernwegen, die sich automatisch anpassen.
 Deine Rolle: Als Product Lead machst du aus dieser Vision eine Strategie und aus der Strategie ein Produkt. Du trägst die strategische Produktverantwortung für die MaxBrain SaaS-Plattform. Du entwickelst sie konsequent vom Markt, von Kundenproblemen und vom wirtschaftlichen Nutzen her. Du setzt Prioritäten, reduzierst Komplexität und schaffst Klarheit.
 Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden.
 

 Deine Aufgaben 
 Produktvision und -strategie: Du entwickelst die Vision von MaxBrain als People-Development-Plattform weiter und übersetzt sie in eine klare Produktstrategie. Du legst fest, welche Probleme wir für welche Kunden lösen und welche nicht.

 Markt und Positionierung: Du kennst den L&D- und HR-Tech-Markt im DACH-Raum. Du beobachtest Wettbewerb und Trends und schärfst gemeinsam mit dem CEO unsere Positionierung.

 Fokussierte Roadmap: Du leitest aus Strategie und Kundenbedürfnissen eine nutzenorientierte Roadmap ab. Du setzt klare Prioritäten und sagst auch Nein. Du reduzierst Komplexität, statt Feature-Listen zu verwalten.

 Produktmanagement: Du erkennst und validierst Kundenbedürfnisse und triffst daraus klare Produktentscheidungen. Du konzipierst Features im Design-Thinking-Prozess, verantwortest das funktionale und das UX-Design und schreibst klare User Stories.

 Lernen als strategische Infrastruktur: Du verankerst Lernen in den HR-Prozessen, die bei unserer Kundschaft täglich laufen: Onboarding, Compliance, Jahresgespräche und Weiterbildung. Integrationen in HR-Systeme wie Personio, Abacus oder Microsoft machen die Plattform zur Infrastruktur statt zur Insel.

 KI als Hebel: Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge intensiv für Research, Spezifikation, Prototyping und Design. So deckst du mit einem schlanken Setup viel ab und entscheidest schneller und besser.

 Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Engineering, Sales und Customer Success. Du schaffst Alignment über Prioritäten und Nutzen.

 Dein Profil 
 Du hast einen nachweisbaren Track Record im L&D-, EdTech- oder HR-Tech-Umfeld.

 Du bringst 5–7 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management, Product Design oder einer vergleichbaren Produktrolle mit, idealerweise mit einem komplexen B2B-SaaS-Produkt.

 Du hast eine Produktstrategie entwickelt und umgesetzt. Du hast Produkte oder grössere Features von der Discovery bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung geführt. 

 Du kennst Corporate Learning und People Development. Erfahrung mit LMS, Skill- und Performance-Management oder angrenzenden HR-Produkten ist ein grosses Plus.

 Du denkst strategisch und arbeitest hands-on. Du sprichst gerne direkt mit Nutzern, strukturierst komplexe Probleme und arbeitest selbstständig mit Design- und Prototyping-Tools wie Figma.

 Du denkst in Nutzerproblemen statt in Features. Du wägst Kundenwünsche, Marktchancen, Unternehmensziele und Aufwand gegeneinander ab.

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. C1). Französisch, Italienisch oder Kroatisch sind ein Plus.

 Eine Kultur, die lebt, was wir verkaufen: Wir lernen selbst jeden Tag dazu, teilen Wissen offen und nehmen «Make Learning Matter» auch intern ernst.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Product Owner 
 Amsterdam - Lijkt het jou interessant om als product owner aan een applicatie voor miljoenen gebruikers te werken waarbij je grote invloed hebt op de architectuur en technische ontwikkelingen? Lees dan snel verder! 
 Wat ga je doen? 
 Als Product Owner bij Reclamefolder.nl ben je de operationele rechterhand van de Product Manager en zorg je ervoor dat het productteam altijd weet wat er gebouwd moet worden, waarom dat belangrijk is en hoe succes wordt gemeten. Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Daarmee lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat 872000 unieke bezoekers per maand ontvangt. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Dit doe je onder andere door: 
 Productkeuzes en inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek te vertalen naar goed uitgewerkte features met heldere user stories, acceptatiecriteria, edge cases en meetpunten. 

 Refinements voor te bereiden, de backlog actueel en overzichtelijk te houden en ervoor te zorgen dat web-, iOS-, Android- en backendteams altijd vooruit kunnen werken. 

 Het eerste aanspreekpunt te zijn voor developers, UX en de Tech Lead bij functionele vragen en binnen de gestelde kaders zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen over scope en uitwerking. 

 De scope tijdens development te bewaken, functionele validaties voor te bereiden met testscenario's en acceptatiechecks en opgeleverde features te controleren op iOS, Android en web. 

 Verzoeken van DPG Media, sales en andere interne stakeholders te analyseren, samen te werken met de UX'er en data-analist aan de juiste KPI's en meetpunten en advies te geven over prioritering. 

 Wie zijn wij? 
 Wij zijn Reclamefolder.nl. Wij geloven dat het mogelijk is om mensen te helpen besparen op hun dagelijkse uitgaven. Onze website en apps ontvangen wij maandelijks 875000 unieke gebruikers en onze ambitie reikt verder. We bevinden ons midden in een transformatie waarin de digitale folder volledig wordt vernieuwd en het platform opnieuw wordt opgebouwd. 
 Reclamefolder.nl heeft een ondernemende cultuur met ongeveer 25 collega's binnen IT, marketing en sales. Hoewel we onderdeel zijn van DPG Media, opereren we zelfstandig. Hierdoor heb je veel invloed op de productontwikkeling en bedrijfsvoering, terwijl je tegelijkertijd profiteert van de kennis en expertise van een grote mediaorganisatie. 
 Je werkt in een multidisciplinair productteam bestaande uit een Product Manager, webdeveloper, iOS-developer, Android-developer, backenddevelopers, een UX'er, een data-analist en een Tech Lead. In deze rol geef je de Product Manager ruimte om zich te richten op discovery, strategie en klantcontact, terwijl jij zorgt voor een backlog met features die klaar zijn om ontwikkeld te worden. 
 Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
 
 2 jaar ervaring als Product Owner 

 Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal en ervaring met het werken in multidisciplinaire productteams. 

 Ervaring met het zelfstandig uitwerken van backlog-items voor een digitaal product en samenwerking met developers, bijvoorbeeld als Product Owner, Business Analyst of in een vergelijkbare rol. 

 Ervaring met het schrijven van duidelijke user stories en acceptatiecriteria die zonder aanvullende toelichting door ontwikkelaars kunnen worden opgepakt. 

 Het vermogen om stakeholderverzoeken te vertalen naar een helder probleem met een duidelijke scope en prioriteit, waarbij je waar nodig duidelijke keuzes maakt. 
 

 Pré 
 Ervaring met digitale producten die beschikbaar zijn op iOS, Android en web. 

 Ervaring binnen retail media, advertising, e-commerce of marketplaces. 

 Basiskennis van tracking en analytics, zoals events, funnels en dashboards. 

 Ervaring met het opstellen van een meetplan voor nieuwe features. 

 Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier! 
 Wat krijg je van ons? 
 Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn!

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
De backlog is niet het probleem. De vraag achter de vraag wel. 
 Een volle backlog is geen visie. Een roadmap is geen strategie. En een sprint review is geen impact. Als Senior Product Owner weet je dat. Je hebt de complexe omgevingen gezien, de politieke stakeholders, de systemen met twintig jaar technische schuld. Je bent niet op zoek naar een functie waarbij je uren vult. Je zoekt een omgeving die jou scherp houdt.
 
 De uitdaging 
 Bij LINKIT werk je als Senior Product Owner op opdracht bij organisaties waar de complexiteit hoog is: ministeries, grote corporates, data-intensieve omgevingen waar één verkeerde prioritering maanden vertraging oplevert. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en levering, tussen de directie die richting wil en het team dat die richting uitvoerbaar moet maken.
 
 Dat betekent in de praktijk dat je eindverantwoordelijk bent voor backlog, prioritering en roadmap, en dat je die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ook als stakeholders tegengestelde belangen hebben. Je vertaalt abstracte organisatiedoelen naar concrete productkeuzes. Je stuurt op waarde én op compliance, op snelheid én op continuïteit. En je laat teams en producten structureel beter achter dan je ze aantrof.
 
 Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat op opdracht bij klanten in sectoren als overheid, finance en logistiek. De techniek, omgeving en prioriteiten van de omgevingen wisselen; de verwachting dat jij eigenaarschap pakt, niet.
 
 Jouw plek 
 Bij LINKIT werken we in squads, dit zijn onze expertise teams. Elke twee weken is er de clubdag: alle Explorers komen op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor kennissessies, verdieping en verbinding. Tot 10% van je werktijd gaat naar leren en groeien, niet als bijzaak maar als onderdeel van hoe LINKIT werkt.
 
 Wat we vragen 
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in complexe IT-omgevingen.

 Aantoonbare Agile/Scrum ervaring; SAFe is een sterke pré.

 PSPO I en PSPO II certificering (aanvullende certificeringen zijn een pré).

 Ervaring binnen enterprise-organisaties, overheid of infra-omgevingen.

 Affiniteit met data-intensieve omgevingen en begrip van architectuur, integraties, migraties, security en compliance op hoofdlijnen.

 Afgeronde hbo-opleiding.

 Professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

 Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.
 
 Wat je krijgt 
 Salaris tussen €6.000-€7.000 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

 Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

 Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

 Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

 Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

 Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

 Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, , zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

 
 Sollicitatieprocedure 
 We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.
 Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

 Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

 Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

 Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Siënna via 
 Over LINKIT 
 LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. 
 Als Senior Product Owner werk je op opdracht bij onze klanten, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Platform (SaaS / Remote)
jobs.description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? 
 
 The Mission: 
 Publitas turns retailers' static catalogs into interactive, shoppable digital experiences for brands across Europe and North America. We're a small, fully remote product organisation. 
 You'll be hands-on: in the codebase, in the data, prototyping with AI and shipping yourself. The default assumption is that you can figure it out, not that someone else will figure it out for you. 
 

 What you'll own 
 A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome. 

 Your first 90 days 
 Day 30 - You know your key stakeholders, have a baseline understanding of the product area and its challenges, and a working relationship with the team. You understand how the product is built and where the data lives well enough to form your own view, not one handed to you. A first version of the roadmap is on the table. 

 Day 60 - You've made your first major call - a scope cut, a kill, a bet - grounded in evidence and explicit about what would change your mind. You've found the gap between what was decided in your area and what actually ships, and closed at least one. You've put something real in front of customers or the team that you built yourself - a prototype, a working change - rather than waited for. 

 Day 90 - Your roadmap is trustworthy: Now, Next and Later are current and nobody has to ask what's happening. You've shipped your first prototype yourself, and your team is working AI-first. 

 
 
 What we need from you 
 Builder depth. You understand how software is built well enough to prototype against live services with AI tools, pull your own data, and ship without waiting for an engineer. 

 Evidence over summaries. You've made expensive go/no-go calls - a migration, a vendor choice, killing a product - from the evidence underneath, and you can explain what you decided, why, and what would have changed your mind. 

 Senior product experience. You've scaled a B2B product and know what that takes: the retention politics, the roadmap pressure from customer-facing teams, the trade-offs nobody wants to make. 

 Lived AI experience. You've shipped real work where AI did part of it and you can tell us exactly where it went wrong. You think in workflows and systems, not prompts. 

 Proactivity in an async team. You set priorities, make trade-offs, and decide what ships. 

 Excellent written English. We're fully remote and async-first; most of your influence travels in writing. 

 
 What We Offer You to Win 
 Compensation : Your salary is geo-bracketed to your location, with flexibility within the bracket based on your experience and what you bring to the role. A clear, performance-based path for progression follows from there.

 Real Ownership: Full autonomy over priorities, sequencing, and what ships within your pillars, plus the mandate to define how an entire product organization works with AI.

 True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

 Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

 Modern Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

 Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

 Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

 
 At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. 
 Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are "AI-curious"; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Safety & Compliance 
 CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.
 The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.
 If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.
 
 In this role, you’ll get to: 
 Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

 Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

 Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.

 Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.

 Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.
 

 Who you are and what you’ll need for this position: 
 You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS. 

 You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.

 You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.

 You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.

 You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.

 You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.

 You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.

 You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."

 You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones

 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with trust and safety, content moderation, risk scoring or compliance tooling.

 Experience with multimodal AI, content classification or ML evaluation workflows.

 Experience with regulated content and privacy rules: FTC disclosure guidelines, music and content licensing, alcohol promotion, or GDPR and CCPA, and how they shape product requirements.

 Experience shipping customer-facing APIs, webhooks or enterprise integrations.

 Familiarity with social media platforms, martech or influencer workflows.

 
 Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!
  
 What you will get from us: 
 People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

 Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

 Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

 Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

 Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Score
jobs.description:
Product Manager - Score 

As our Product Manager, you’ll lead the continued development of the core functionality of our Product, working closely with our Engineering team and wider Product Management team to help continue to evolve our core platform while maintaining quality and stability.‍

You’ll develop a deep understanding of the Score architecture, the Score Data model and our unique data verification technology to enable you to advise both Engineering and Product on how best to extend the functionality of the platform.

The role will require collaborating with a variety of stakeholders across product, development, design, customer success, sales, and senior management, to understand the business’ technological needs, balance priorities, and ship the right products and features to the market.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Become the product expert and specialist on the core Score platform who can discuss the product with a wide range of stakeholders
  • Understanding and mapping of complex business processes into requirements
  • Mapping business rules into data validation and verification logic
  • Management of the backlog for a scrum team
  • Ensuring the principles and concepts of the platform are reflected in new development
  • Use your combination of technical and business expertise to bridge the gap between complex business needs and technical implementation

Skills we'd love you to have

  • Backend Software Development or Technical Delivery experience
  • Demonstrated product experience and attention to detail
  • Experience with Agile product development frameworks and key supporting tools
  • Know how to work with, and challenge, stakeholders to gather complex requirements and prioritise
  • You have previously worked in a startup or an early-stage, fast-growing team or company.‍‍

Why ClearScore and Score?

Score is rebuilding the UK’s £1.4 trillion mortgage market from the ground up, with a completely new, end-to-end management system for mortgages.

Our platform cuts out the unnecessary admin, pain and friction from buying a home. We're covering the entire journey, from figuring out what you can borrow, to getting your keys.

We're guided both by the voice of real home buyers and by our close relationships with brokers, lenders and insurers. We won’t stop until the process of buying, mortgaging, conveyancing, and insuring your home is affordable and completely seamless.

Join our product team to help change the way people buy homes!

jobs.description:
Co-reactive is a fast-growing greentech company with a clear mission: We transform CO₂ into high‑performance construction materials, enabling climate‑friendly building for everyone. At our brand‑new site in Erkrath, we unite laboratory, production, and development under one roof. Our pilot plant already showcases what the construction industry of tomorrow will look like.

 To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Head of Cementitious Product who will take full ownership of translating our R&D efforts into market‑ready, certifiable, and scalable products. In this role, you sit at the critical interface between research, engineering, operations, and customers ensuring that our technology becomes a repeatable product that succeeds technically, regulatorily, and commercially.

 At Co-reactive, we embrace a maker mentality and a common goal: reshaping the construction sector. As a startup team, we move fast, make decisions quickly, and implement them decisively. You will take over customer projects once they are set up and lead them to successful product delivery.

 We value diverse perspectives and open communication. Embedded in a strong network of customers, industry partners, and technical experts, you will have significant autonomy to shape our product portfolio and play a defining role in scaling a breakthrough climate technology.

 Tasks

 As Head of Cementitious Product, you are responsible for shaping, executing, and safeguarding Co-reactive’s products from early customer projects to scalable, certifiable, and market‑ready offerings. You translate scientific innovation into robust products by combining technical depth, customer focus, and structured execution across the organization.

 
 Take full ownership of translating Co-reactive’s R&D efforts into market‑ready, certifiable, and scalable construction material products, ensuring clear product definitions aligned with market, regulatory, and industrial requirements

 Assume responsibility for customer projects once they are set up and lead them through implementation to successful technical, regulatory, and product outcomes, acting as the single point of accountability for product‑related success

 Define, lock, and manage product scopes, specifications, performance requirements, and boundary conditions for customer‑specific and standard products, balancing customer needs with long‑term platform strategy

 Act as the central interface between R&D, engineering, operations, and customers, translating scientific insights and experimental results into concrete product definitions, application concepts, and use‑case‑specific solutions

 Drive engineering refinements and product optimization with a strong focus on manufacturability, scale‑up readiness, robustness, cost implications, and repeatability across sites and customers

 Own decisions on which feedstocks are suitable for which products and applications, and evaluate and validate product performance for targeted use cases, ensuring technical credibility, comparability, and scalability

 Lead the product‑side certification and regulatory pathway, including REACH, CE marking, DIBt approvals, and relevant EN/DIN standards, and translate regulatory requirements into clear product development priorities

 Act as technical key account lead for strategic customers during product execution, supporting sales and business development with credible technical‑product narratives, documentation, and customer‑ready materials

 Manage the evolution of the product portfolio across lifecycle stages, from prototype and pilot products to pre‑commercial and commercial offerings, and prepare structured, data‑driven product recommendations for executive decision‑making

 
 Requirements

 You combine technical depth with a strong sense of ownership and pragmatism. You are motivated to take complex technology and turn it into real‑world products that can be deployed at scale.

 
 Degree in Materials Science, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field; a PhD is a strong plus

 6+ years of experience in product development, technical project leadership, or application engineering in construction materials, cement, concrete, mineralization, or related industries

 Solid understanding of cementitious materials, inorganic materials, mineral processes, or industrial materials systems

 Proven experience with certification, standards, and regulatory frameworks for construction materials (e.g. REACH, CE, EN/DIN, DIBt)

 Experience working at the interface of R&D, engineering, and customers, ideally in industrial or scale‑up environments

 Strong ability to structure complex problems, make trade‑offs, and drive execution across teams

 Excellent communication skills, able to bridge scientific, industrial, and commercial perspectives

 Hands‑on mindset, high level of ownership, and passion for climate‑positive construction technologies

 
 Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Taurus 
 Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
 Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
 Tasks
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
 This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Main Responsibilities 
 Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

 Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

 Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

 Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

 Requirements
 Your Profile 
 Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

 Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

 Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

 Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

 Willingness to travel to client locations as required

 Benefits
 What We Offer 
 An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

 A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

 A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

 A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

 As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.
 Note 
 We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

Focusing on building fundamental Bitcoin infrastructure, Blockstream quickly grew into one of the leading technology power houses of the industry.

jobs.title: Social & Follower - Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.
  
 Your expedition: Product & Growth
  
 This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.
  
 While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers .
  
 The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature ) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.
 
 Your itinerary
 What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. 
 You will:
 Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

 Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

 Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

 Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

 Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

 Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

 
 The equipment in your backpack
 What we're hoping you'll bring with you. 
 ✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role
 ✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.
 ✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth
 ✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)
 ✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back
 ✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo
 ✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience
 
 1st class extras
 Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. 
 Salary range: Between EUR 70.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 85.000 - 95.000 (senior level) gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

 Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan

 A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here. 

 A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

 Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

 An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you). 

 Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

 The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

 A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

 A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

 Delicious daily team lunches.

 Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

 A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

 Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.
